title: Aml Sar
description: Aml Sar contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: docubricks-fs-aml-sar
  title: Aml Sar
  description: Aml Sar contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
  version: fs_aml_sar_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: fs/aml_sar
    sourcePath: Schemas/fs/aml_sar
    sourceVersion: fs_aml_sar_v1
    sourceDigest: 86e5972c040bbf5bf9d8ccecdf041db81aa5ca181d62f3a4803b985ec98dbecb
spec:
  role: review
  pages:
    - id: main
      title: Aml Sar
      sections:
        - id: dates-and-terms
          title: Dates And Terms
          description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: filing-date
              name: filing_date
              label: Filing Date
              description: Filing date
              dataType: date
              widget: date
            - id: activity-start-date
              name: activity_start_date
              label: Activity Start Date
              description: Activity start date
              dataType: date
              widget: date
            - id: activity-end-date
              name: activity_end_date
              label: Activity End Date
              description: Activity end date
              dataType: date
              widget: date
        - id: document-details
          title: Document Details
          description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: sar-id
              name: sar_id
              label: Sar Id
              description: Sar id
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: subject-account-number-masked
              name: subject_account_number_masked
              label: Subject Account Number Masked
              description: Subject account number masked
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: suspicious-activity-type
              name: suspicious_activity_type
              label: Suspicious Activity Type
              description: Suspicious activity type
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: transaction-count
              name: transaction_count
              label: Transaction Count
              description: Transaction count
              dataType: integer
              widget: number
            - id: currency
              name: currency
              label: Currency
              description: Currency
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: law-enforcement-contacted
              name: law_enforcement_contacted
              label: Law Enforcement Contacted
              description: Law enforcement contacted
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: narrative-summary
              name: narrative_summary
              label: Narrative Summary
              description: Narrative summary
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: financials
          title: Financials
          description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: subject-tax-id-masked
              name: subject_tax_id_masked
              label: Subject Tax Id Masked
              description: Subject tax id masked
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: amount-involved
              name: amount_involved
              label: Amount Involved
              description: Amount involved
              dataType: number
              widget: number
        - id: parties
          title: Parties
          description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: filing-institution-name
              name: filing_institution_name
              label: Filing Institution Name
              description: Filing institution name
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: subject-name
              name: subject_name
              label: Subject Name
              description: Subject name
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: investigator-name
              name: investigator_name
              label: Investigator Name
              description: Investigator name
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: property-or-asset
          title: Property Or Asset
          description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: subject-address
              name: subject_address
              label: Subject Address
              description: Subject address
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: branch-location
              name: branch_location
              label: Branch Location
              description: Branch location
              dataType: string
              widget: text
  validationRules:
    - id: subject-name-present
      severity: error
      description: SAR subject name is required for case investigation and filing.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: subject_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: subject_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: subject_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(subject_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: Amount involved cannot be negative.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: amount_involved
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: amount_involved
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: amount_involved IS NULL OR amount_involved >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: transaction-count-positive
      severity: warning
      description: Transaction count should be positive when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: transaction_count
          - op: gt
            left:
              field: transaction_count
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: transaction_count IS NULL OR transaction_count > 0
      supported: true
    - id: activity-date-order
      severity: warning
      description: SAR activity start date cannot be after activity end date.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: activity_start_date
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: activity_end_date
          - op: lte
            left:
              field: activity_start_date
            right:
              field: activity_end_date
      sourceExpression: activity_start_date IS NULL OR activity_end_date IS NULL OR activity_start_date <= activity_end_date
      supported: true
    - id: activity-type-present
      severity: warning
      description: Suspicious activity category should be captured for AML analytics.
      rule:
        op: present
        field: suspicious_activity_type
      sourceExpression: suspicious_activity_type IS NOT NULL
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      subject_name:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Primary SAR subject identity field.
      activity_start_date:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Activity date range is required for suspicious activity reporting.
      activity_end_date:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Activity date range is required for suspicious activity reporting.
      amount_involved:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Amount involved supports SAR threshold review and trend analysis.
      suspicious_activity_type:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Activity type routes AML typology and filing workflow.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-dbrx-instruct
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-claude-sonnet
    maxTokens: 2048
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: SAR forms contain labeled filing fields plus short narratives. DBRX Instruct is appropriate for
      direct structured extraction; Claude Sonnet is retained for longer narrative summaries and ambiguous
      suspicious activity typologies.
  submissionSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      sar_id:
        type: string
        description: Sar id
      filing_institution_name:
        type: string
        description: Filing institution name
      filing_date:
        type: date
        description: Filing date
        format: date
      subject_name:
        type: string
        description: Subject name
      subject_tax_id_masked:
        type: string
        description: Subject tax id masked
      subject_address:
        type: string
        description: Subject address
      subject_account_number_masked:
        type: string
        description: Subject account number masked
      activity_start_date:
        type: date
        description: Activity start date
        format: date
      activity_end_date:
        type: date
        description: Activity end date
        format: date
      suspicious_activity_type:
        type: string
        description: Suspicious activity type
      amount_involved:
        type: number
        description: Amount involved
      transaction_count:
        type: integer
        description: Transaction count
      currency:
        type: string
        description: Currency
      law_enforcement_contacted:
        type: string
        description: Law enforcement contacted
      narrative_summary:
        type: string
        description: Narrative summary
      branch_location:
        type: string
        description: Branch location
      investigator_name:
        type: string
        description: Investigator name
    required:
      - subject_name
    additionalProperties: false
    x-ladder-docubricks:
      completenessChecklist:
        - id: required_fields_present
          description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
          fields:
            - subject_name
        - id: section_coverage_reviewed
          description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
          sections:
            - dates_and_terms
            - document_details
            - financials
            - parties
            - property_or_asset
        - id: nested_lists_normalized
          description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
          fields: []
